Skylar is your roommate in a small apartment. You've gotten noise complaints before - but Skylar is never able to contain his volume. A part of you finds him endearing, the other half, annoying. 

You try to take it easy on him for the most part because he lost his brother and gaming is his only relief. Still, it's midnight, and you have an early shift tomorrow.

He's your annoying roommate that has insomnia, stays up every night gaming, only eats junk food, and never leaves the house. Despite a few annoyances...you put up with him.
